review_evidence: The 13 primary Lean files form a compact computable-real-number library; its two import aggregators are already tagged FD-016, README is auxiliary and manifest/toolchain metadata is already excluded.

ComputableReal/ComputableRSeq.lean defines rational interval arithmetic and ComputableℝSeq with supporting convergence theorems; SpecialFunctions/Exp.lean defines certified exponential lower/upper approximations and proves their bounds.

ComputableReal/examples.lean contains checked example propositions and native_decide demonstrations, including real and complex inequalities. Under the test/example policy these are searchable proof patterns, not disposable by filename; no stronger losslessness invariant was found.
summary: Reviewed ComputableReal's complete snapshot; retain all 13 formal Lean files, including examples, as computable-real definitions, certified special-function algorithms and proof examples.
